Bengal by-elections: Rebel TMC faction names candidates

A faction of the Trinamool Congress (TMC) has announced its candidates for the upcoming by-elections to the Nandigram and Rejinagar assembly seats, scheduled for October 6. The announcement was made by the group described as the 'Mamata faction' and also referred to as the 'rebel TMC camp'. This move indicates a division within the party as it prepares for the by-elections.
